Sry, in the last days i tried to make a reproducer, but have many troubles to get it working with an schema database online. I hope the stacktrace can help or another person has also the same error. 

In the meantime i am running quarkus 2.4.1 succesfully in production. This error is only at startup, everything else is working correctly

I see in your stacktrace that you have several classes in package `at.tanzauswertung.shared`.

Is your tenant resolver in a shared JAR? If so, are you sure beans from that JAR are correctly discovered (see how beans are discovered in dependencies [here](https://quarkus.io/guides/cdi-reference#bean_discovery))? If not, you might simply be missing a Jandex index for this JAR: https://quarkus.io/guides/cdi-reference#how-to-generate-a-jandex-index.

It's strange that bean resolution would work at runtime, though...
Sadly my tenant resolver is not in the shared JAR.

For what it's worth, we are seeing the same issue and -- as far as I can tell by looking at the posted configuration -- one thing we have in common with @Paul6552 is that we are using Flyway and we have set too
`quarkus.flyway.migrate-at-start=false
`

In our case the error gets printed just before flyway migration kicks in.
